title: SafeScientist: Toward Risk-Aware Scientific Discoveries by LLM Agents
reasoning: The paper evaluates AI safety and ethical responsibility in scientific discovery through its SafeScientist framework and SciSafetyBench. It includes an 'Ethical Reviewer' component that scores 'ethical adherence' and uses a 'Safety Score Evaluator' to assess ethical risk based on guiding principles derived from conference ethical standards.
